sources.shortCitation: Syrena Grand Record 17921, “A zresztą… niech pan zadzwoni” (1926)
sources.fullCitation: Orkiestra teatru „Perskie Oko”, conducted by Zygmunt Wiehler. “A zresztą… niech pan zadzwoni.” Shimmy. Syrena Grand Record no. 17921, matrix 17921, 1926. The transfer is published by Stare Melodie from a disc lent by a private collector; its description credits the music to Henryk Chwast under the pseudonym Bruno Asper, both of them names recorded here for Bronisław Kaper. Accessed 20 August 2026.
sources.title: A zresztą… niech pan zadzwoni — Syrena Grand Record 17921
sources.creator: Orkiestra teatru „Perskie Oko”; Zygmunt Wiehler, conductor

sources.shortCitation: Syrena Record, “Zgaś lampę!” — Henryk Gold ensemble, 1926
sources.fullCitation: Henryk Gold and his ensemble. “Zgaś lampę!” Shimmy, composed in 1926 under the name Bruno Asper and current both as a cabaret song and as an instrumental piece; the upload states that this instrumental version was recorded that year for Syrena in Warsaw by the acoustic process. No catalogue or matrix number is given and the disc is not shown. Published on YouTube by jurek46pink. Accessed 20 August 2026.
